integrity.claimed_domain: Finite poset incidence algebras with commutative unital coefficients and R-linear square-identity maps
integrity.reproducibility: Full constructive proof, two standalone finite-system checkers and recorded outputs
integrity.unproved_limits: No extension to non-R-linear maps, arbitrary preorders or infinite incidence algebras; no independent priority certification.

scientific_limitations: Finite antisymmetric posets and coefficient-linear maps over commutative unital rings only.
Numerical census requires the coefficient ring to be finite.
Previously known incidence-derivation decomposition and the integral homology of the projective plane are acknowledged, not new claims.
Full-text historical priority comparison remains incomplete for certain broader idempotent-algebra papers.
Independent mathematical review has not been performed.
title: Square-identity rigidity and torsion-sensitive derivation counts for finite poset incidence algebras
